paired_comparison.scope: DELETE only, embedded/server, 3/1000/10000 rows, same retained baseline and unchanged harness
paired_comparison.limits: internal same-profile optimization comparison, not public0.8.16/reference qualification; lifetime CPU includes setup, no per-operation IO claim
paired_comparison.reporting: Report each trial median/MAD and all warmups/measured raw values without exclusions. Diagnostic noise band=max(5% of baseline median,3*baseline measured MAD); not a release threshold.

mutation_scope.focused: Four predicate/join/affected-count mutations in execute_delete_with_returning; two explicit test targets in both build/test phases. Fast-path removal is separately caught by unchanged-product negative control.
mutation_scope.interrupted_attempt: Initial cargo-test arguments scoped test phase only, not no-run build; interrupted owned process after discovering broad build. One generated Default return was unviable: ExecutionResult does not implement Default. No pass claimed.

development_verification.negative_control: baseline compilation succeeded; indexed hit, miss/null and reversed equality failed; fallback passed

coupling.accepted: Reuse existing primary-key index helper; existing DELETE/constraints cascade cycle remains. The report identifies paths via constraints to INSERT/MERGE/UPDATE; explicit FK restrict/cascade, rollback and joined tests cover affected semantics. No new storage/index format or boundary is introduced.

development_verification.strengthening: 3-row integration tests and physical row-read instrumentation; no new unsafe or arithmetic algorithms; Miri/Kani not applicable; no surviving mutant currently identified

mutation_check.scope: delete.rs lines104/115/134; predicates/join/rows_affected; unchanged-product negative control separately tests lookup removal
